title: It is just a gimmick!
text: It is just a gimmick!. Maybe I am just uncoordinated, but I couldn't get these to work. I ordered several sets as I have about 24 plants. They arrive flat and you are supposed the bend the little legs down so you can stick them in the ground. Then you pull the edge of the rounded sides together and snap it to form a cone-ish shape to hold the plant up. I was unable to get the legs to stay bent, they kept slowly coming back up towards a flat position - so they eventually were not above the ground but just lying flat on it. and the cone part doesn't stay snapped either.  I tried a bunch of times and eventually gave up.  Unable to return as I go them all dirty and banged up trying to get them to work. Neat idea - just can't execute it. Don't waste your time and money on a gimmick that will undoubtedly fail you.
